# The Screen Team LLC

> Tampa Bay pool cage rescreens, new enclosure coordination, super gutters, and screen repair. Owner Chris Westcott handles every estimate — no call centers.

- [Website](https://screenteamllc.com)
- [Sitemap](https://screenteamllc.com/sitemap.xml) — ~80 indexable pages

- [All services](https://screenteamllc.com/services.html)
- **Phone:** (727) 386-6562
- **Email:** chris@screenteamllc.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Free estimates:** Yes
- **Minimum job charge:** $150 on every completed visit

## Priorities (what Chris wants to sell)

1. **Full / large pool cage rescreens** — [full-pool-cage-rescreen.html](https://screenteamllc.com/full-pool-cage-rescreen.html)
2. **New enclosure builds** (Screen Team scopes; licensed partners when permits/engineering required) — [new-pool-cage-installation.html](https://screenteamllc.com/new-pool-cage-installation.html)
3. **Super gutters** (structural enclosure gutters) — [super-gutters.html](https://screenteamllc.com/super-gutters.html)
4. Small jobs still welcome (windows, panels, garage screens)

## Who to contact

Chris Westcott owns The Screen Team LLC. Call (727) 386-6562 for quotes.

## Pricing (ballparks)

See [pricing](https://screenteamllc.com/pricing.html).

- Panels from ~$75; **$150 minimum** per job
- Partial repairs often $175–$750
- Full cage rescreens from ~$1,995 (most $2,500–$6,500+)
- Super gutters: custom per linear foot
- New pool cages: custom ($10k–$30k+ typical range; partner path when permitted)

## Business conventions (do not misstate)

- Do not publish or invent a street address.
- Do not claim "licensed and insured" unless updated by the owner.
- New builds: Screen Team leads scoping/customer relationship; permit-heavy engineering via partners.
- $150 minimum applies to every completed job.
